title: Ext comparison intertwines classical right-derived pullback
statement: Let $X,X^{\prime}$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:X^{\prime}\to X$ a morphism, $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Put $L=g^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], $\Gamma=\Gamma(X,-)$ and $\Gamma^{\prime}=\Gamma(X^{\prime},-)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Let $e:\Gamma\to L\Gamma^{\prime}$ be the underived unit section map followed by $\Gamma(X,g_*-)\cong\Gamma(X^{\prime},-)$ [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-derived-unit]. There exist isomorphisms $r:\operatorname{Sheaf.H}(G,q)\xrightarrow{\sim}R^q\Gamma(G)$ and $r^{\prime}:\operatorname{Sheaf.H}(LG,q)\xrightarrow{\sim}R^q\Gamma^{\prime}(LG)$ comparing Ext cohomology with classical derived global sections [lem-weil-pbc-sheafH-ext-derived-comparison], such that $r;\operatorname{rightDerivedBaseChange}(e,q)_G=\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g,G,q);r^{\prime}$, where the latter pullback is the Ext map [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback].

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 01F8 (lemma-functoriality), equations 01F9 (equation-functorial-derived) and 01FA (equation-functorial), Remark 01FB (remark-explain-arrow); sites-cohomology.tex Remark 08J6 for the site version.

proof.text: Choose the injective resolutions of G and LG, apply exact inverse image to the first, and lift the resulting augmentation into the second using the K-injective comparison theorem.

Compute Ext in these resolutions. Evaluation at 1 identifies the inverse-image Ext cocycle map with the section-unit map followed by the lift, term by term. The evaluations commute with differentials, so the induced homology maps agree. Construct r and r prime by composing the Ext/resolution equivalence, the homology of evaluation-at-1 equivalence, and the classical right-derived/resolution equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Unit construction of cohomology pullback, equations 01F9 and 01FA.
proof_origin.note: Specific interface comparison; not compatibility of arbitrary additive equivalences.

theorem sheafHRightDerivedIso_pullback {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) :
    let Γ := Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let Γ' := Sheaf.Γ X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
    let L := upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g'
    let e : Γ ⋙ 𝟭 _ ⟶ L ⋙ Γ' :=
      (Functor.rightUnitor Γ).hom ≫ (Functor.leftUnitor Γ).inv ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').unit Γ ≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft L (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').hom
    ∃ (r : (Sheaf.functorH.{u + 1} X.smallEtaleTopology q).obj G ≅
        (Γ.rightDerived q).obj G)
      (r' : (Sheaf.functorH.{u + 1} X'.smallEtaleTopology q).obj (L.obj G) ≅
        (Γ'.rightDerived q).obj (L.obj G)),
      r.hom ≫ (Functor.rightDerivedBaseChange e q).app G =
        AddCommGrpCat.ofHom (cohomologyMap g' G q) ≫ r'.hom
